notes: Every loop is seamless: play it with gapless looping, never re-encode to MP3.
All rates of one scenario share the same bed: crossfade between them at a trough (troughs_s) for an inaudible switch.

Every soundscape works with any carrier in carriers_hz: the bed is notched -6 dB in a 1/3 octave around each, takes with tonal hum near any of them were rejected, and the tone layer keeps every partial at least 20 Hz from all of them. Run the binaural carrier at one of these frequencies; any other may beat against the tone layer.
No beat or AM is baked in: the app's music driver adds it.
envelope_csv columns: time_s, wave_phase, envelope_0to1, gain_db, pan, at 20 Hz.

prompts: A long-haul airplane cabin at night in smooth cruise, heard from a seat over the wing. A deep, even engine drone blended into soft broadband air noise, muffled and warm, cabin lights dimmed. Steady and unchanging from start to finish: one even, continuous texture.

The back seat of a well-insulated car cruising at constant speed on fresh, smooth highway asphalt at night. A soft continuous tire roar, a low steady engine hum and a gentle hush of air around the closed windows. Steady and unchanging from start to finish: one even, continuous texture.

Distant ocean surf heard from inside a beach house with the window open, a continuous soft wash of far-away waves blending into one steady roar. Constant level throughout, no swelling, no surges, no fades, no build-ups. No individual crashing waves, no seagulls, no wind gusts, no voices.

The steady low roar of the sea heard from a hilltop far inland, so distant that countless waves have merged into one smooth, continuous hush. Steady and unchanging from start to finish: one even, continuous texture.

The deep, even rumble of a vast ocean heard through the closed windows of a house on a cliff, a wide soft wall of sound with no single wave standing out. Steady and unchanging from start to finish: one even, continuous texture.

Heavy steady rain heard from inside a quiet house through a closed window, muffled and distant. One dense, continuous, soft roar in which the drops blend together into an even wash; no single drops, drips or taps stand out. Constant level throughout, no swelling, no surges, no fades, no build-ups. No thunder, no wind gusts, no dripping gutters, no splashes, no birds.

Heavy steady rain heard from inside a quiet house through a closed window, muffled and distant: one dense, soft roar in which countless drops blend into an even wash. Steady and unchanging from start to finish: one even, continuous texture.

Steady heavy rain on a roof, heard from a cozy room on the floor below, so muffled that it becomes one smooth, low, enveloping hush. Steady and unchanging from start to finish: one even, continuous texture.

A wide, deep river flowing steadily, heard from a grassy bank a short way back: a smooth, dense water wash with a soft, even gurgle woven through it. Steady and unchanging from start to finish: one even, continuous texture.

Inside an empty modern high-speed train at night, heard from a padded seat. A deep, smooth rumble under a soft broadband air hiss, the faint even hum of wheels on welded rails and a warm cabin resonance. Steady and unchanging from start to finish: one even, continuous texture.

A soft, constant breeze high in tall pine trees at night, heard from a sheltered clearing: a smooth airy hush of countless needles. Steady and unchanging from start to finish: one even, continuous texture.
